maria_ops: Heads up - EU cooling queue at FRA racks 12/13 causing ~30% effective GPU capacity drop. Seeing thermal throttles on 4 H100s, nodes are getting kicked from the cluster.
jonathan_procurement: Ack. I pinged GalaxCo earlier today - their lead time for replacement H100s is 12-18 business days unless we accept refurbished units. Pricing delta is ~+8% for expedited. Do we want to push for expedited replacements?
li_am: Short term: can we shift workloads to DEDICATED pool in AMS? Network egress to AMS is fine but latency-sensitive jobs might see +20ms p99. Tom, does that break any SLOs?
tom_sre: moving to AMS dedicated pool is safe for batch jobs; interactive chat endpoints will be impacted for a subset of customers in EU-west. We'll need to toggle routing policy -> canary on per-cid basis. I can prepare a rollback if p99 > 300ms.
ashley_logistics: GalaxCo RMA flow: they require unit serials and photos. ETA for air-ship if we opt expedited is 3-5 days to FRA inbound + 2 days customs. If we do sea, 14-21 days.
maria_ops: We need RMA paperwork ASAP - someone grab the serials from the depot manifest. Also confirm whether they will send LOANER units while RMA processes. Last time they offered 2 loaners per case but only for white-glove customers.
jonathan_procurement: GalaxCo reply: "We can provide 2 loaners for 7 days, then either extend at cost or swap with refurbished replacements." They also mentioned two SKU mismatches may trigger additional inspection delay. I asked for AWB numbers and provisional MAWB.
vendorbot: Shipment update: AWB: GB1234567890 scheduled pickup 2026-03-25 08:00 UTC. Provisional MAWB: MAW-98765. Customs docs: commercial invoice pending.
li_am: Can we get interim capacity by redistributing inference shards across remaining H100s? That will increase token cost ~12% but keep tail latency stable for priority customers.
tom_sre: Redistribution will work but we must increase KV cache warming to avoid regen spikes. I'll push a config change: `service.runtime.kv.prefetch=1.5` for EU routes. Will schedule during low traffic window (02:00-04:00 CET).
ashley_logistics: For RMA photos please use the depot checklist: `serial, top label, underside sticker, mounting bracket, packaging damage`. Send to vendor portal and cc ops@redwood.ai.
maria_ops: Decision needed: (A) expedite GalaxCo replacements (air) + accept +8% expedite fee for immediate loaners, or (B) accept refurbished sea replacements with 2-week lead and no loaners. Pros/cons? We have 3 priority customers that will notice degraded interactive latency under B.
jonathan_procurement: Recommend A for customer impact reasons. I'll authorize expedited fee if leadership signs off. Need aproval from finance for the +8% ad-hoc.
li_am: If we go A, we should also request serialized tracking and an express customs broker (I can loop in our broker) to shave 48h.
maria_ops: Perfect. @jonathan_procurement can you confirm payment approval and request loaner confirmation from GalaxCo? I'll collect serials and prep RMA upload.
jonathan_procurement: On it. I'll post the PO and payment confirmation in this thread once done.
ashley_logistics: Once AWB is confirmed I'll open a temporary inbound slot with FRA depot and flag arrival to SOC for pre-staging.
vendorbot: Note: when loaners shipped, warranty period remains with original unit per GalaxCo policy. Document exchange protocol: upload signed RMA + photos; vendor will issue LOANER AWB within 24h of docs accepted.
maria_ops: Thanks team - timeline looks like: collect serials today, request expedite + loaners now, expect loaner AWB by 2026-03-25, replacement H100s into depot by 2026-03-28. I'll update the SRE incident with rollback plan. :white_check_mark:
jonathan_procurement: PO posted: PO-8853. Finance approval pending final sign-off from @cecilia_finance. I'll tag once approved.
li_am: Also flag cost center: infra-eu-ops. We'll track the +8% as a one-off to infra budget.
tom_sre: I'll start the KV prefetch change at 02:05 CET and monitor latency. If any spike, roll back at 02:20.
maria_ops: Closing loop: assign follow-ups -> jonathan (vendor payment/loaner), ashley (depot staging), li (broker + cost tag), tom (runtime change). Report back with timestamps in thread.
